text:
asha: quick triage 1: invoices show traffic billed to project-gamma but the key used is owned by project-beta. Tracing shows proxy exchange rewriting X-Project. @liam can you look?

liam: on it. paste the logs/headers you have?

asha: minimal repro: client uses API_KEY (owner=project-beta) -> edge proxy exchanges to sa -> upstream sets X-Request-Project=project-gamma -> billing ingests that field. Logs:
```n2026-01-08T14:04:11Z auth: key=key_qw owner=project-beta org=org-b
2026-01-08T14:04:12Z proxy: exchange->sa:sa-b set X-Request-Project=project-gamma
2026-01-08T14:04:13Z billing: project=project-gamma key=key_qw
```

liam: so billing trusts the effective project header. That will misattribute quota and invoices.

zoe: UX impact is bad1 customers see usage in a different project. Proposal: surface both minted-by and executed-as in console usage rows. small inline info link explaining provenance.

asha: short-term mitigation plan:
- auth to emit `X-Auth-Attribution: owner=project-beta;exec=project-gamma;via=proxy-exchange` header so downstream systems have canonical data
- add metric tag `auth.attribution=owner:project-beta|exec:project-gamma` (sampled 1%)
- change billing/enforcer to prefer key-owner by default (avoid surprising charges). Add per-key flag `billing_target` (owner|effective) default owner.

liam: agree owner-first for enforcement. We do need an explicit opt-in for delegated billing (parent org scenarios). Implement API to set `billing_target` when creating/updating keys.

zoe: console should default to owner billing. If a user enables effective billing we show a modal: "This will bill requests to the project that executed the request. This affects quotas and invoices." Also show recent examples if available.

asha: telemetry sampling: baseline 0.5% global; escalate to 100% capture for a key when mismatch alert fires or for keys with low traffic that need debugging. Adaptive sampler config.

liam: add enforcement header validation: only auth service can set owner field. Set downstream services to drop/ignore owner rewrites. Edge proxy must preserve X-Auth-Attribution and not let upstream overwrite owner.

zoe: migration/backfill: dashboards currently only have project field. We'll run a backfill job joining billing rows to key-registry to recompute owner when possible and mark rows `attribution_recomputed`. Add invoice FAQ for the migration window.

liam: alerting: new alert when owner-based vs effective-based counters diverge >10% over 30m for a key. Also low severity alert for header variance across pods.

ops-bot: @liam mentioned in eng-platform  created TASK- AUTH-7200 add X-Auth-Attribution header and metric tag

asha: tasks/action owners:
- liam: auth service header + tests + docs (PR)
- zoe: console UX + copy + modal
- liam: sampler + alert rule
- asha: migration plan + runbook

liam: i'll open the PR and add integration tests simulating proxy exchange. will also add feature flag `auth.attrib.mode=owner` for staged rollout.

zoe: will post mockups and draft tooltip text.

asha: thanks team. This should stop surprise billing and give us reliable telemetry to debug routing policy issues without spamming logs.
